name: Peeira
body:
Peeira
CR 3

This pale-skinned fey wears a roughspun smock and crude leather slippers. Its shaggy hair is thick, long, and wild, in contrast to its delicate insectile wings.

XP 800
CN Medium fey
Init +3; Senses low-light vision. scent; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural)
hp 33 (6d6+12)
Fort +4, Ref +8, Will +6
DR 5/cold iron

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee dagger +6 (1d4+1/19–20)
Melee shortbow +6 (1d6/x3)
Special Attacks pact protection, wolf meld
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 6th; concentration +9)

Constant—speak with animals
3/day—charm animal (DC 13), longstrider
1/day—goodberry, lesser restoration, magic fang

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 17, Con 15, Int 14, Wis 13, Cha 16
Base Atk +3; CMB +4; CMD 18
Feats Dodge, Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +12, Climb +10, Handle Animal +10, Knowledge (geography) +11, Knowledge (nature) +11, Perception +10, Sense Motive +10, Stealth +15
Languages Common, Elven, Sylvan; speak with animals
SQ wild empathy

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Pact Protection (Su)

Once per round as an immediate action, the peeira can command a wolf to attack a creature targetting the peeira. The wolf, as an immediate action move up to it’s speed and make a single attack against the creature. The commanded wolf must be within 120 feet of the peeira and the peeira must be aware the creature is targetting peeira. If the wolf is in the pack the peeira is bound to, the wolf performs this action only if it fails a DC 15 Will save. Otherwise, the wolf must fail a Will save to perform this action. The save is Charisma-based.

Wild Empathy (Su)

This works like the druid’s wild empathy class feature, except the peeira has a +6 racial bonus on the check.

Peeiras with druid levels add this racial modifier to their wild empathy checks.

Wolf Meld (Su)

Once per round, the peeira can merge its body with a wolf. This ability is similar to a magic jar spell (caster level 6th), except that it does not require a receptacle. To use this ability, the peeira must be adjacent to the target wolf. The wolf does not get a save if the wolf is in the peeira’s pack. If the target wolf is not in her pack, the wolf can resist with a successful Will save. A creature that successfully saves is immune to that same peeira’s wolf meld for 24 hours. While merged with the peeira, the wolf gains regeneration 1 (cold iron)

ECOLOGY

Environment cold or temperate forests
Organization solitary with a wolf, with a pair of wolves, or with a pack (3-12 wolves)
Treasure standard

A peeira is a fey who is bound to a particular pack of wolves, serving as its guardian and healer. As such, she is the bane of hunters who trap or kill wolves for their furs. With an otherworldly beauty, she stands with an imperious attitude surrounded by her pack of wolves. While fierce and wild, however, the peeira is generally good-natured, steering her pack clear of lost travelers or children and eager to keep them from being man-eaters.

While a peeira is not actively hostile towards outsiders, it is very protective of its pack and the territory in which they hunt. Those who hunt her pack or despoil their hunting grounds gain the fey’s ire, and she will not rest until such interlopers are dead or driven from the area.

The presence of a peeira can have a calming effect on werewolves, suppressing their bloodlust and wicked nature.

Over time, if a werewolf chooses to run with theh peeira’s pack, she can teach the werewolf to control its bestial urges and turn from its murderous ways.
